payload.summary: CME and On Call: resumable drafts and 'waiting on someone else' task states
payload.detail: Review items D06 and D07. Drafts marked Saved on this device / Saved to your account / Not saved, resumable without duplicate submission, cleared or protected on sign-out and account change. Tasks split into My next action / Waiting for supervisor / Waiting for workforce / Completed, with who must act and when to follow up. A pending request never becomes approved by elapsed time.
payload.source: Master product review 2026-09-26 (thread: Review master review ideas); cross-checked against main 004ab6301
